checks.name: Both languages cover the same baseline labels
Only own queue can retry and Viewer cannot retry
Offline blocks new calls and uploads but preserves pending snapshots
Queue, project and request limits have separate execution gates
Session expiry masks content and pauses uploads; wrong account cannot resume
Logout waits for an explicit decision about pending records
Admin cannot self-join; Owner requires a nonempty audited reason
Initialization consumes one-time bootstrap state; registration requires email verification
Credential recovery requires an existing backup and reauthentication
Deleting a backup does not erase local credentials or revoke the grant
Public URL queries save; credentials, fragments and sensitive references do not
Server conflict retains draft and requires explicit save after reapply
Environment conflict retains local value and can load remote explicitly
stdio confirmation is required again after execution config changes
Incomplete valid JSON draft cannot publish even as Maintainer; metadata survives save
allOf, anyOf and local references are validated without coercion
Unresolved remote references block execution instead of passing with a warning
Simulated browser recovery keeps only a redacted queue snapshot
Uploaded redaction uses an explicit revision, preserves linked metadata, and strips originals
Expired history cleanup preserves pinned, saved and pending records
Developer cannot toggle a project retention pin, Maintainer can
Another user’s upload queue cannot be retried through history actions
Uploaded rule preview does not mutate the committed snapshot
oneOf selected branch still requires its fields and rejects invalid branch values
Browser refresh cannot leave an apparently running resumable request
